people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
translations.bsb: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
translations.kjv: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
translations.asv: nor seeking glory of men, neither from you nor from others, when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
